messages.subject: Re: Subsetting a csv file?
parts:
It's hard to answer without knowing what your Cali data frame looks like. Could you show us what a str(Cali) looks like?

On Wed, Jul 22, 2015 at 11:49 AM Chris <cjschm...@gmail.com> wrote:
I am new to Shiny, and was looking for some help when plotting CSV files. This is my current server file, and I want to subset the data to only include the columns within the range. How could I do this?

shinyServer(function(input, output) {
  output$text1 <- renderText({
    paste("You have selected a range that goes from", input$range[1], "to", input$range[2])
    })
  output$plot <- renderPlot({
    Cali <- read.csv("C:/Users/Chris/Documents/Intership/RoundTable/data/CASmall.csv",header=TRUE)
    barplot(Cali$LWBSPercent,col = c("Blue","Red","Purple","Green"), xlab="Hospitals", ylab="LWBS%",
            border=NA,ylim=c(input$range[1]*.01, input$range[2]*.01),xpd=FALSE)
  })
})
